Play Twilight Princess in VR. Dusklight VR renders the game in true per-eye stereo with 6DOF head
tracking, puts the HUD and menus on crisp floating panels, and adds a tabletop mode that turns Hyrule
into a diorama on your real table.

**Features**
- True per-eye stereo and 6DOF head tracking, with a level-horizon comfort option
- HUD and menus on floating panels; Dusklight's own menus in the headset
- Cinema mode: the flat game on a big virtual screen
- Tabletop mode: the world as a diorama on your table, with x-ray view of Link through walls, a flat
  table HUD and a quick item wheel that doesn't pause
- Aim lines and 3D lock-on markers for every aiming item; the Hawkeye on a 3D screen
- Comfort options: third-person aiming, camera turns only when you turn it, black fades
- Presets for every mode and a tabbed VR settings window (VR in the top bar)

**Requirements**
- Windows: Dusklight v2.0 (D3D12) and any OpenXR runtime (SteamVR, Virtual Desktop, Quest Link, ...)
- Quest 3: the Dusklight VR edition APK from the release page
- Linux / Steam Frame (alpha): the official Dusklight v2.0.3 AppImage (Vulkan) and SteamVR or Monado
- Your own Twilight Princess (USA) disc image

**About this mod**
Built with heavy AI assistance (Claude). Windows and Quest are tested in a headset; Linux / Steam
Frame support is an alpha, tested so far only with a simulated headset. Bug reports with logs are
welcome.
